1.identification: a) P.D. v/l towing, tow length > 200 m, underway, seen from stbd. side. b) v/l or object towed, tow length > 200 m, seen from stbd. side.
1.action: a) Maintain course and speed. b) Two short blasts, a/c to port and pass round stern of last v/l or object towed.
1.lights_displayed: a)(i) Masthead lts ford and aft. (ii) Side lts and stern lt. (iii) Length < 50 m - aft masthead lt not compulsory. (iv) Two addl masthead lts in vert line with ford or aft masthead lt. (v) Yellow towing lt above stern lt. b) Side lts and stern lt or adequately illuminated.
1.fog_signal: a) One prolonged and two short blasts. b) Last v/l towed, if manned - one prolonged and three short blasts.

2.identification: a) P.D. v/l towing, tow length > 200 m, underway, seen from port side. b) v/l or object towed, tow length > 200 m, seen from port side.
2.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd. and pass round stern of last v/l or object towed.
2.lights_displayed: a)(i) Masthead lts ford and aft. (ii) Side lts and stern lt. (iii) Length < 50 m - aft masthead lt not compulsory. (iv) Two addl masthead lts in vert line with ford or aft masthead lt. (v) Yellow towing lt above stern lt. b) Side lts and stern lt or adequately illuminated.
2.fog_signal: a) One prolonged and two short blasts. b) Last v/l towed, if manned - one prolonged and three short blasts.

3.identification: Last of inconspicuous, partly submerged v/l or object towed, tow length ≤ 200 m seen from stbd. side.
3.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port.
3.lights_displayed: a) Breadth < 25 m - all round white lts ford and aft. b) Breadth ≥ 25 m - Addl - all round white lts at extremeties of breadth. c) Length > 100 m - Addl - all round white lts in between above lts at horz intervals ≤ 100 m. d) Dracones - Ford lt not compulsory.

4.identification: Last of inconspicuous, partly submerged v/l or object towed, tow length > 200 m.
4.action: a/c away from tug giving appropriate signal.
4.lights_displayed: a) Breadth < 25 m - all round white lts ford and aft. b) Breadth ≥ 25 m - Addl - all round white lts at extremeties of breadth. c) Length > 100 m - Addl - all round white lts in between above lts at horz intervals ≤ 100 m. d) Dracones - Ford lt not compulsory.

5.identification: S.V. underway, also propelled by machinery, seen from stbd. side.
5.lights_displayed: a) Masthead lts ford and aft. b) Side lts and stern lt. c) Length < 50 m - aft masthead lt not compulsory.
5.fog_signal: a) Making way - one prolonged blast b) Stopped - two prolonged blasts with two secs. interval in between.

6.identification: S.V. underway, also propelled by machinery, seen from port side.
6.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd.
6.lights_displayed: a) Masthead lts ford and aft. b) Side lts and stern lt. c) Length < 50 m - aft masthead lt not compulsory.
6.fog_signal: a) Making way - one prolonged blast b) Stopped - two prolonged blasts with two secs. interval in between.

7.identification: a) v/l fishing with nets or lines extending ≤ 150 m horizontally from v/l, underway or at anchor, seen from stbd. side. b) Trawler, underway or at anchor, seen from stbd side.
7.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port.
7.lights_displayed: a)(i) All round red over white lts in vert line. a)(ii) Making way - side lts and stern lt. b)(i) All round green over white lts in vert line. b)(ii) Masthead lt abaft of and higher than green lt. b)(iii) Making way - side lts and stern lt. b)(iv) Length < 50 m - masthead lt is not compulsory.
7.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

9.identification: v/l fishing with nets or lines extending > 150 m horizontally from v/l, underway or at anchor, seen end on from ahead or astern.
9.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port away from gear.
9.lights_displayed: a) All round red over white lts in vert line. b) Making way - side lts and stern lt. c) All round white lt in direction of gear.
9.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

11.identification: v/l NUC, underway, seen from stbd. side.
11.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port.
11.lights_displayed: a) Two all round red lts in vert line. b) Making way - side lts and stern lt.
11.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

12.identification: v/l RAM, except mine clearance v/l, underway, seen from stbd. side.
12.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port.
12.lights_displayed:
a) All round red, white and red lts in vert line. 
b) Making way - masthead lts ford and aft, side lts and stern lt. 
c) Length < 50 m - aft masthead lt not compulsory.
12.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

13.identification: v/l RAM, except mine clearance v/l, at anchor, seen from port side.
13.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd.
13.lights_displayed: a) All round red, white and red lts in vert line. b) All round white lts ford and at stern. c) Working lts to illuminate deck. d) Length < 100 m - working lts not compulsory. e) Length < 50 m - working lts and white lt at stern not compulsory, and ford white lt placed where it can best be seen.
13.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

14.identification: P.D. v/l towing, RAM, tow length > 200 m, underway, seen from stbd. side.
14.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port and pass round stern of last v/l or object towed.
14.lights_displayed: a) Masthead lts ford and aft. b) Side lts and stern lt. c) Length < 50 m - aft masthead lt not compulsory. d) Two addl masthead lts in vert line with ford or aft masthead lts. e) Yellow towing lt above stern lt. f) All round red, white and red lts in vert. line
14.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

15.identification: Dredger, RAM, underway or at anchor, seen end on from ahead or astern.
15.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port towards safe side.
15.lights_displayed: a) All round red, white and red lts in vert line. b) Two all round red lts in vert line on obstruction side. c) Two all round green lts in vert line on safe side. d) Making way - (i) Masthead lts ford and aft, side lts and stern lt. d)(ii) Length < 50 m - aft masthead lt not compulsory.
15.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

16.identification: Small v/l engaged in diving operations, seen from stbd. side.
16.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port.
16.lights_displayed: All round red, white and red lts in vert line.
16.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

17.identification: v/l engaged in mine clearance operations, underway, seen end on from ahead or astern.
17.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd. and pass > 1000 m clear of v/l.
17.lights_displayed: a) Three all round green lts - one at foremast head and one at each end of fore yard. b) Masthead lts ford and aft, side lts and stern lt. c) Length < 50 m - aft masthead lt not compulsory.
17.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

18.identification: v/l engaged in mine clearance operations, at anchor, seen from port side.
18.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd. and pass > 1000 m clear of v/l.
18.lights_displayed: a) Three all round green lts - one at foremast head and one at each end of fore yard. b) All round white lts ford and at stern. c) Working lts to illuminate deck. d) Length < 100 m - working lts not compulsory. e) Length < 50 m - working lts and white lt at stern not compulsory, and ford white lt placed where it can best be seen.
18.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

19.identification: P.D. v/l constrained by draught, underway, seen from stbd. side.
19.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd. and pass round her stern.
19.lights_displayed: a) Three all round red lts in vert line. b) Masthead its ford and aft, side lts and stern lt. c) Length < 50 m - aft masthead lt not compulsory.
19.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

20.identification: Pilot v/l underway, seen from stbd. side.
20.lights_displayed: a) All round white over red lts in vert line at or near masthead. b) Side lts and stern lt.
20.fog_signal: a) Making way - one prolonged blast. b) Stopped - two prolonged blasts with two secs. interval in between. c) Optional - four short blasts.

21.identification: Pilot v/l underway, seen from port side.
21.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd.
21.lights_displayed: a) All round white over red lts in vert line at or near masthead. b) Side lts and stern lt.
21.fog_signal: a) Making way - one prolonged blast. b) Stopped - two prolonged blasts with two secs. interval in between. c) Optional - four short blasts.

22.identification: Pilot v/l at anchor, seen from stbd. side.
22.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port.
22.lights_displayed: a) All round white over red lts in vert line at or near masthead. b) All round white lts ford and at stern. c) Working lts to illuminate deck. d) Length < 100 m - working lts not compulsory. e) Length < 50 m - working lts and white lt at stern not compulsory, and ford white lt placed where it can best be seen.
22.fog_signal: a) Length < 100 m - rapid ringing of bell for 5 secs. b) Length ≥ 100 m - rapid ringing of bell ford for five secs and rapid ringing of gong aft for five secs. c) Optional - four short blasts.

23.identification: v/l at anchor, seen from port side.
23.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd.
23.lights_displayed: a) All round white lts ford and at stern. b) Working lts to illuminate deck. c) Length < 100 m - working lts not compulsory. d) Length < 50 m - working lts and white lt at stern not compulsory, and ford white lt placed where it can best be seen.
23.fog_signal: a) Length < 100 m - rapid ringing of bell for five secs. b) Length ≥ 100 m - rapid ringing of bell ford for five secs and rapid ringing of gong aft for five secs. c) Optional - one short, one prolonged and one short blasts.

24.identification: v/l aground, seen from stbd. side.
24.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd, reverse course and inform Master.
24.lights_displayed: a) Two all round red lts in vert line. b) All round white lts ford and at stern. c) Length < 50 m - white light at stern not compulsory, and ford white Light placed where it can best be seen.
24.fog_signal: a) Length < 100 m - rapid ringing of bell for five secs. b) Length ≥ 100 m - rapid ringing of bell ford for five secs and rapid ringing of gong aft for five secs. c) Three separate and distinct strokes on bell before and after ringing of bell. d) Optional - appropriate whistle signal (two short and one prolonged blasts).

25.identification: Trawler, underway, shooting nets, seen from stbd. side.
25.action: Two short blasts, a/c to port.
25.lights_displayed: a) All round green over white lts in vert line. b) Masthead lt abaft of and higher than green lt. c) Making way - side lts and stern lt. d) Length < 50 m - masthead light not compulsory. e) Two all round white lights in vertical line at lower level than green and white lights.
25.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

26.identification: Trawler, underway or at anchor, hauling nets, seen from port side.
26.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd.
26.lights_displayed: a) All round green over white lts in vert line. b) Masthead light abaft of and higher than green light. c) Making way - side lts and stern lt. d) Length < 50 m. - masthead light not compulsory. e) All round white over red lights in vertical line at lower level than green and white lights.
26.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

28.identification: Two trawlers engaged in pair trawling, underway, shooting nets, seen end on from ahead or astern.
28.action: One short blast, a/c to stbd.
28.lights_displayed: a) All round green over white lts in vert line. b) Masthead light abaft of and higher than green lt. c) Making way - side lts and stern light. d) Length < 50 m. - masthead light not compulsory. e)(i) Two all round white lts in vert line at lower level than green and white lts. e)(ii) Search lt directed forward and in direction of other trawler.
28.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

29.identification: Two trawlers engaged in pair trawling, underway or at anchor, hauling nets, seen end on from ahead or astern.

29.lights_displayed: a) All round green over white lts in vert line. b) Masthead light abaft of and higher than green lt. c) Making way - side lts and stern lt. d) Length < 50 m. - masthead light not compulsory. e)(i) All round white over red lights in vertical line at lower level than green and white lights. e)(ii) Search light directed forward and in direction of other trawler.
29.fog_signal: One prolonged and two short blasts.

30.identification: Two trawlers engaged in pair trawling, stopped or at anchor, nets fast on obstruction, seen end on from ahead or astern.

30.lights_displayed: a) All round green over white lts in vert line. b) Masthead light abaft of and higher than green light. c) Length < 50 m - masthead lt not compulsory. d)(i) Two all round red lts in vert line at lower level than green and white lts. d)(ii) Search lt directed forward and in direction of other trawler.

11.title: Flag A
11.identification: I have a diver down; keep well clear at slow speed.

12.title: Flag B
12.identification: I am taking in or discharging or carrying dangerous goods.

14.title: Code and Answering Pendant
14.identification: Code and Answering pendant (used to acknowledge or indicate code signals).

15.title: Flag D
15.identification: I am altering course to starboard.

16.title: Flag E
16.identification: I am disabled. Communicate with me.

17.title: Flag F
17.identification: I require a pilot.When made by fishing vessels operating in close proximity of fishing grounds, it means "I am hauling nets".

18.title: First Substitute
18.identification: First substitute (repeats the first flag of the same group).

19.title: Flag G
19.identification: I am altering course to port.

20.title: Flag H
20.identification: I am on fire and have dangerous cargo on board, keep well clear of me.

21.title: Flag I
21.identification: I wish to communicate with you.

22.title: Flag J
22.identification: You should stop your vessel instantly.

23.title: Flag K
23.identification: My vessel is stopped and making no way through the water.

26.title: Flag N
26.identification: In harbour - The vessel is about to proceed to sea. All persons report for duty.When displayed at sea it means "My nets have come fast upon an obstruction".

27.title: Flag O
27.identification: My vessel is healthy and I request free pratique.

28.title: Flag P
28.identification: This flag has no single letter meaning.

30.title: Flag R
30.identification: Keep clear of me. I am engaged in pair trawling.

32.title: Second Substitute
32.identification: Second substitute (repeats the second flag of the same group).

34.title: Third Substitute
34.identification: Third substitute (repeats the third flag of the same group).

36.title: Flag V
36.identification: I require a tug.When made by fishing vessels operating in close proximity on the fishing grounds it means "I am shooting nets".
